text:
Ava: Quick sync — bench narrative for launch landing. Keep it concise: claim + datapoint + CTA per tile.
Noah: Agree. Proposal: Scatter (latency vs $/k tokens), tail histogram, and a mini cost calculator. One-line claim + one stat.
Jules: I'll run a 1h microbench (80 concurrent chat sessions) and post CSV + assumptions. Using redwood-medium, q4_0, continuous batching.
Taylor: I'll mock three tiles and a small GIF for the calculator. Need CSV and assumptions by EOD to finalize copy.
Priya: Two CTA variants to test: 'Estimate your spend' and 'Try with free credits'. Wire different UTMs and track conversions.
Ava: Webinar plan: prerecord demo (8m), live Q&A (20m). Host: Ava. Tag engaged attendees as MQL if they ask technical questions.
Noah: Public-facing claim: 'Reduce per-token cost by up to 35% for chat workloads.' Put exact baseline numbers in appendix.
Jules: Run command: ./tools/bench --concurrency 80 --duration 3600 --model redwood-medium --quant q4_0 --batch continuous --out bench_6965.csv
Taylor: Copy drafts: Tile A claim + stat, Tile B cost % comparison, Tile C tail latency histogram note. Will share images tomorrow morning.
Ava: Final asks: Jules upload artifacts, Taylor drop visuals, Priya wire landing+UTMs. Deck review tomorrow 10:00 PT. Locking plan unless objections.
Priya: I'll draft routing: attended & asked_question -> SDR; score>75 or company_size>200 -> AE.
Noah: I'll author appendix with baseline details and measurement methods.
Ava: Thanks team — moving to issues. :rocket:
